label: ProductLaunchVendorCompliance process: Calculate Material Cost Impact — Determine financial implications of material selections and invoice-based historical pricing metrics.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

PURCHASE ORDER & PROCUREMENT:
API: sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1 ✓ BEST for safety material ordering
Agent: sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 ✓ BEST for cost impact analysis using historical pricing & vendor metrics
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 (invoice matching, not cost calculation)

PRODUCT LAUNCH VENDOR COMPLIANCE PROCESS:
Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 ✓ Part of ProductLaunchVendorCompliance process (step 1)
- Validates BOM against supplier qualifications
- Workflow: BOMCompliance → Material/Vendor selection → Cost Impact calculation → Invoice validation

WORKFORCE SAFETY & COMPENSATION:
Agent: sap.sf:agent:OccupationalSafetyComplianceMonitor:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1

ENGINEERING & CHANGE MANAGEMENT:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 ✓ material provisioning
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 ✓ BOM validation
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1 ✓ vendor identification

COST IMPACT CALCULATION:
★ sap.s4:agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1 — Core for material cost impact
  - Evaluates vendor pricing + historical performance metrics
  - Optimizes procurement decisions based on cost analysis
  - Analyzes purchase requisitions against vendor pricing data
  - Determines financial implications of vendor/material selections

args.reason: This agent evaluates vendor pricing and historical performance metrics to determine optimal procurement decisions, directly addressing material cost impact calculation with invoice-based pricing data.
